lede: Wednesday and Thursday bring back-to-back hearings on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific — HARC takes up the preliminary architecture review for all the building clusters, and a special Town Council session hears the appeal of P&Z's lot-consolidation approval, which is the legal foundation the whole project rests on. The county is also workshopping a proposed Employee Housing Impact Fee that could reshape how development is priced across San Miguel County. Around all that, the week has its share of good things: Original Thinkers kicks off Thursday, Pink Talking Fish hits the Sheridan Friday, and the Annual San Miguel River Cleanup is Saturday.
